The second clearly confuses page and book units.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J02334","case1_error":"Uses 12 cups per set instead of 24, omitting the two-dozen multiplier.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 8 + 12 + 16 + 4 as 30 instead of 40.","reason":"The first constructs the total with an omitted factor; the second evaluates a correctly written sum incorrectly.","judgment":"different"}]}
